PC: Assess the patient’s knowledge and confidence regarding the care of her chronic illnesses.
Inquire about barriers to the care of the patient’s illness and problem-solve with the patient to overcome these barriers.
Inquire about any new concerns that have arisen since the patient’s last visit and check in regarding her ongoing medical issues.
How confident does she feel about her ability to manage her illnesses?
What are her goals for managing her illnesses?
What changes in her behavior does she want to make to meet these goals?
What barriers, if any, have made it difficult for her to reach these goals?  (note: consider financial barriers, health literacy, lack of time, psychosocial stressors etc)
ICS: Open the interview (greet the patient, make introductions, negotiate an agenda for the follow-up visit with the patient)
Build a relationship and establish rapport with patient
Engage in open-ended inquiry, listening, summarizing

Students will be expected to practice a technique of interviewing today for follow-up patients in which they should elicit the full spectrum of patient concerns at the outset of the interview, followed by a brief collaborative agenda-setting period.
Explore Mrs Henderson’s culture and how it has impacted her reactions to her chronic illness.
